document:
Exercise: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- isometric

Primary Muscles:

- lower back

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.75

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_lower_back_flexibility
- strengthen_core_muscles

Contraindications:

- lower back pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
- Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
- To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.
